newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan domestic WPI up 1.8% y/y in July 2nd 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Japan domestic WPI up 1.8% y/y in July 2nd 10 days.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index, a key component of the overall WPI, was unchanged in the second 10 days of July from the previous 10-day period, but was up 1.8 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Tuesday.
The overall WPI was also unchanged from the previous 10-day period but was up 1.6 percent from a year earlier.
The export and import indices - the other components of the overall WPI - were up 0.5 percent and 0.1 percent, respectively, from the previous 10-day period.
Against the same 10-day period a year earlier, export prices were down 1.2 percent, while import prices were up 4.3 percent.
